definitions.explanation: Something that happens or takes place. Can refer to both positive and negative events, from everyday occurrences to significant incidents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧{出来事|できごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me about what happened today.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{出来事|できごと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一生|いっしょう}→一生：01728_isshou⟧⟦{忘|わす}れられない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I will never forget that incident for the rest of my life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予想外|よそうがい}→予想外：03188_yosougai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出来事|できごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised by the unexpected event.

notes:
USAGE: {出来事|できごと} is a neutral term for events or occurrences. It can be used for anything from daily happenings to major incidents.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{出来事|できごと} (big event)
- ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{出来事|できごと} (small incident)
- ⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出来事|できごと} (everyday occurrences)
- ⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧な{出来事|できごと} (historical event)
- ⟦{思|おも}いがけない→思いがけない：19375_omoigakenai⟧{出来事|できごと} (unexpected event)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧ - incident, case (often negative, newsworthy)
- ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧ - accident
- ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧ - event (often planned, loanword)
- ⟦{催|もよお}し→催し：00295_moyooshi⟧ - event, function (organized)
- ⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧ - event, function (scheduled/traditional)
